Per-unit posterior summary for a mvgam_latent_state object

Source: R/mvgam_latent_state.R
summary.mvgam_latent_state.Rd

Collapses the [ndraws, n_unit] draw matrix to one row per unit carrying the posterior median plus 50% and 95% credible interval endpoints. The returned data.frame is the same one that as.data.frame.mvgam_latent_state() returns and that plot.mvgam_latent_state() uses internally.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_latent_state'
summary(object, probs = c(0.025, 0.25, 0.75, 0.975), ...)

Arguments

object

A mvgam_latent_state object.

probs

Numeric vector of length 4 giving the lower / inner-lower / inner-upper / upper interval probabilities. Defaults to c(0.025, 0.25, 0.75, 0.975) (50% and 95% intervals).

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

A data.frame with columns series, time, median, lower_50, upper_50, lower_95, upper_95.
